notes.title: Desktop Heroes - UI Improvements
notes.content: [h2][b]Update – Complete Code-base Overhaul[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Entire game code-base has been restructured for a more flexible foundation, enabling future advanced features.[/p][/*][*][p][u][b]Important:[/b] This update is [b]not compatible[/b] with previous versions. All old saves and progress will be deleted upon updating.[/u][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]UI & UX Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]All UI elements redesigned[/b] with improved visuals and usability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skillbar:[/b][/p][list][*][p]5-slot customizable skill bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Rearrange skills via [b]right-click[/b] or [b]drag-and-drop[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Menus[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Character Menu[/b][/p][list][*][p]Displays character state and stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Includes stat upgrade and skill set.[/p][/*][*][p]Skills can be dragged directly to the skill bar.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Backpack Menu[/b][/p][list][*][p]Full shared inventory with drag-and-drop support.[/p][/*][*][p]Items can be moved to the skill bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Upcoming feature: [b]Gear section[/b] for equipping items from the backpack.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Item Tooltips[/b][/p][list][*][p]Detailed descriptions added for all items.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Crafting Menu[/b][/p][list][*][p]Craft potions usable from the skill bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Effects include HP recovery, double earnings, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Only HP potions are currently available - other potion types coming in the next update.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Team Menu[/b][/p][list][*][p]Unlock, revive, or switch characters through a central hub.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Settings Menu[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fully revised with a cleaner, more intuitive UX.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Language Support[/b][/p][list][*][p]All supported languages are active now.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]Map System[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Map menu separated from other menu tabs with a dedicated, more detailed view.[/p][/*][*][p]Now located outside the bottom-right corner for better accessibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Features:[/p][list][*][p]Buy and switch maps.[/p][/*][*][p]View current map details.[/p][/*][*][p]Enable/disable automatic map level progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Manually move back and forth between map levels.[/p][/*][*][p]See the list of available mobs per map.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Desktop Heroes – Demo Update Notes
notes.content:
[p]Hello Heroes,[/p][p]First of all, thank you for playing the [b]Desktop Heroes[/b] demo and for taking the time to share your thoughts and ideas, as well as any bugs you’ve found. Your feedback has been a huge help in improving the game every day.[/p][p]Our goal is for Desktop Heroes to be a game that you can leave running on your screen while you work, while also surprising, challenging, and making you smile whenever you check back in. With your help, we’re refining the balance, resolving irritating issues and introducing new quality-of-life features to enhance your gaming experience.[/p][p]Today’s update focuses on improving the balance of combat for several characters and maps, giving you more control over your game data and fixing some bugs that were affecting your gold.[/p][p]This is just the beginning. Your adventure has only just started, and together we’re creating something special. So please keep playing and telling us what you think so we can make Desktop Heroes the best idle fantasy adventure you’ve ever had on your desktop![/p][p]Now, let's talk about what's new![/p][p][/p][p][b]New in this Update[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Demo Balancing Update[/b]: Adjustments for Warrior, Hunter, Forest, and Desert.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Mob Health Bar Show/Hide[/b] option in Settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Clear Game Data[/b] option in Settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Restart Game[/b] option in Settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players had to pay again for already purchased items.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Map Level Change[/b] option.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🔴 [u]Important Note:[/u][/b]
If you have played the demo before, your save data will be deleted due to these changes.[/p]
